landingPageLine: Skill defines what I can do. Passion drives what I will do. Discipline decides how far I go.
aboutContent:
My name's Ankit Gupta, and I'm a Full Stack Developer passionate about building dynamic, user-focused web applications and exploring new technologies that make the web faster and smarter.

Although my journey started with curiosity about how digital products work, it quickly evolved into a passion for creating them. Over time, I've worked with the MERN stack, developed strong problem-solving skills, and cultivated a mindset of continuous learning.

I believe that every project is an opportunity to grow — not just as a developer, but as a thinker. Outside of coding, I enjoy exploring new tools, learning about emerging tech, and listening to some relaxing lofi beats.

My goal is to apply my skills to build impactful, scalable solutions that help organizations grow — while continuing to push my own limits as a developer.

projects.title: ShopNow
projects.description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce application using the MERN stack, implementing modular product listing services and state-driven cart management. Built secure authentication and authorization workflows using JWT, along with optimized RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express to ensure scalable and efficient data handling. Engineered a responsive React frontend with component-based architecture, integrating category-based filtering and real-time search functionality for enhanced performance and usability.

projects.title: Investment Portfolio Tracker
projects.description: Developed a real-time investment portfolio dashboard using React and Firebase, enabling live tracking of assets, performance metrics, and overall portfolio growth. Implemented secure user authentication and authorization using Firebase Authentication, along with optimized Firestore data modeling to ensure efficient and scalable data access. Integrated interactive data visualizations and a responsive user interface to present market trends and actionable portfolio insights.

projects.title: ReevaMovie
projects.description: Developed a movie streaming web application using React and Redux, implementing centralized state management to handle real-time data updates for movies and TV shows. Integrated TMDB APIs using Axios to fetch and render trending, popular, and genre-based content efficiently. Designed a responsive and modern user interface with Tailwind CSS, incorporating advanced search and filtering mechanisms to improve content discovery and overall user engagement.
